meaning.vi: Hình thức mái chèo lỗi thời.

sentences.en: Examples of this type are The Satire on Edinburgh, The General Satire, the Epitaph on Donald Owre, and the powerful vision of The Dance of the Sevin Deidlie Synnis.
sentences.vi: Ví dụ về loại này là The Satire on Edinburgh, The General Satire, The Epitaph on Donald Owre, and the Vision of the Dance of the Sevin Deidlie Synnis.

sentences.en: Ah dinna want ti be owre sherp wi ye, but ye dinna seem ti tak ma pynt.
sentences.vi: Ah dinna muốn ti be owre sherp wi ye, but you dinna dường như ti tak ma pynt.

sentences.en: For weill she kent that the wee fowk war back an she wesna gaun ti be the ane ti lat thaim owre the dure.
sentences.vi: For weill she kent that fowk war back an she wesna gaun ti be a an ti lat thaim owre the dure.
